hero.subtitle: Lower sick leave, prevent burnout and sharpen your team's focus with our evidence-based vitality training

methodology.body1: The core of our brain training is strengthening the "control center" for rational choices, focus and conscious action — and the "warning system" that catches stress signals earlier. The result? Less stress and sharper focus.
methodology.body2: Want to know exactly how the method works?
methodology.imageAlt: Training for better performance, less stress and lower sick leave

programOverview.intro: Our core program runs for 6 weeks. Ask us about tailored options for your team.
programOverview.outroQuestion: Want to learn more about how our method works?

weeklyWorkshops.title: Weekly group workshops
weeklyWorkshops.description: A 60-minute group workshop every week, led by one of our accredited trainers.

accreditedTrainers.title: Accredited trainers
accreditedTrainers.description: All our trainers are VMBN-accredited at category 1 for attention training — the highest standard in the Netherlands.

practice.title: 15 minutes of practice
practice.description: Participants aim to practice about 15 minutes a day, 5 days a week, using our workbook and audio recordings.

safeLearning.title: A safe space to learn
safeLearning.description: Participants respond to the trainer's questions in the group; sharing personal context is always optional.

masterclass.subcopyEmployee: Curious but want to experience our method first? You can. In our 60-minute masterclass you'll get a real taste of how we work.
masterclass.subcopyEmployer: Curious but want to check whether the method fits your team first? You can. In our 60-minute masterclass your organization gets a real taste of how we work.

stress.title: Stress level
stress.employee: Get insight into your own stress level. Fully grounded in science.
stress.employer: Employees get insight into their own stress level. Fully grounded in science.

attention.title: Attention exercise
attention.employee: Experience a technique to take back control from autopilot and reclaim your focus.
attention.employer: Employees experience a technique to take back control from autopilot and reclaim their focus.

reset.title: Reset tool
reset.employee: Learn a tool to reset your working memory and instantly bring your attention back.
reset.employer: Employees learn a tool to reset their working memory and instantly bring their attention back.

noCommitment.title: No commitment
noCommitment.text: We believe everyone should be able to try this technique. That's why our masterclass is completely commitment-free.

masterclass.review: "This workshop really shows you why training your attention muscle matters. It's a great mix of theory and exercises, so you immediately get to experience what it's like. I think anyone can benefit from this — highly recommended."

healthcareSystem.title: Method recognized by the Dutch healthcare system
healthcareSystem.description: The full version of our training is reimbursed under basic Dutch health insurance by major insurers.

research.title: 40 years of scientific research
research.description: Built on the MBSR method — one of the most thoroughly researched interventions in the world.

trainers.title: Accredited trainers
trainers.description: All our trainers are VMBN category 1 certified — the highest accreditation within VMBN. This means they meet the strictest standards for training, experience and professionalism.
